  "CRITERIA_MATCH_EXPLANATION": "The paper focuses on regional curriculum harmonization initiatives in the East African Community (EAC), involving multiple countries (Kenya, Uganda, Tanzania, Rwanda, Burundi, and South Sudan). It addresses harmonization across institutions and countries, specifically mentioning regional frameworks, cross-border education, mutual recognition, and credit transfer systems. The paper discusses the EAC Protocol on Education and Training and its implications for harmonizing higher education curricula.",

    "Main_Findings": [
      "Progress has been made in harmonizing higher education curricula in the EAC, particularly in fields like engineering and medicine.",
      "Challenges remain in terms of varying national education systems, funding constraints, and resistance to change.",
      "The EAC Protocol on Education and Training provides a framework for harmonization, but its implementation is uneven across member states.",
      "The EAQFHE and EACATS are important tools for facilitating student mobility and mutual recognition of qualifications."
